intro.headline: Updates
intro.sub: Progress notes, milestones, and the occasional detour.

entries.title: The hearth is lit
entries.body: This site is officially live. Blood Memory is deep in revisions, and What the Roots Remember is still taking shape behind the scenes. More updates to come as both stories grow.

entries.title: Things are heating up
entries.body: Blood Memory is taking shape, the first chapters are undergoing rewrites, but the story is moving forward. Can't give any estimates yet, but the romance is heating up. What the Roots Remember is still in its early stages, but the outline is coming together.
